asr_models.name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming 0.6B (StreamingNemotronMultilingualAsrManager)
asr_models.rtfx: TBD (domain) — LibriSpeech WER 19.77%→18.68% with biasing enabled per FluidAudio's own PR benchmark
asr_models.tagline: PRIORITY WATCH — decode-time, insertion-capable vocabulary biasing confirmed shipped 2026-09-10, untested locally
asr_models.note: UPGRADED PRIORITY this window following direct verification against github.com/FluidInference/FluidAudio: PR #866 ('feat(asr/nemotron): decode-time custom vocabulary biasing, no CTC head required') merged 2026-08-19, shipped in release v0.15.7 (2026-09-10). This is genuine decode-time shallow-fusion biasing for this exact model's streaming ASR path — distinct from, and more capable than, Parakeet TDT's post-hoc CTC rescorer (#401), because it can INSERT a vocabulary term the decoder would otherwise drop, not just swap an emitted word for one. The PR's own reviewer notes confirm Parakeet's sliding-window CTC path is untouched by this change. Measured generically (Earnings22-kws keyword recall 39.3%→59.7%, LibriSpeech WER 19.77%→18.68%) but NEVER tested against this project's own 'Claude Code'/'YOLO' jargon corpus. Per local-findings.md's re-open-trigger contract, this satisfies the clause for 'an alternative Parakeet checkpoint/architecture exposing such a hook' — but the contract also requires re-measurement on the same corpus before any verdict upgrade, which has not happened. Verdict stays `watch`, not `upgrade`; the concrete next step is a local pre-flight test, the same pattern #920/PR #990 followed for Canary-1b-v2.

disfluency_verdict.decision: Fold into the LLM polishing pass
disfluency_verdict.reasoning: Specialized disfluency-removal models (DisfluencyFixer, DISCO) are research-grade and primarily EN/HI/DE/FR — Spanish coverage is sparse. Tier-B LLMs (Gemma 4 26B MoE, Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B) handle disfluency removal extremely well as part of an instruction-following pass. Adding a separate component means another model loaded, another VRAM slot, another point of failure, and worse multilingual coverage than the LLM you already run. This holds regardless of which transcribe/translate front-end eventually feeds it.
disfluency_verdict.prompt:
Clean up this transcript:
- Remove filler words (um, uh, eh, este, like, you know)
- Remove false starts and self-corrections, keep the corrected version
- Tighten conciseness without losing meaning or voice
- Preserve technical terms and proper nouns exactly
- Keep the output in [Spanish/English] — do not translate

Transcript:
{transcript}

top_picks.why: Best small agentic model on this hardware as of late November 2026 — and still the incumbent. Hybrid DeltaNet + sparse MoE, 262k native ctx, 201 languages, Apache 2.0. No 4B-class challenger has shipped as open weights (Qwen4-Max launched closed-weight this window).
